parent: V2.1-pv-predecessor-instrumented, result commit b4130f3, verdict UNRESOLVED
authority: reviewer 2026-09-17: before any new execution, reopen the saved instrumented trajectories at per-cell resolution. Minimal predeclared hierarchy, distributional comparison rather than a search over summary statistics, A against B and C because P1 showed those carry opposite fates. Only RECORDED_MICROSTATE_INSUFFICIENT would justify another instrumented execution
declared: 2026-09-17, committed and pushed before the declared procedure runs
kind: read-only reanalysis of trajectories already produced by SCI-V21-PV-PREDECESSOR. No simulation, no engine call, no parameter of any kind
question: does the fate-carrying information already exist in the recorded microscopic state, earlier than the macroscopic PV-rate divergence at 15 s in run A

traces.location: the session scratch directory named in results/v21_pv_predecessor.json scratch_dir; regenerable by rerunning tests/test_v21_pv_predecessor.py at commit b4130f3
traces.contents: per-PV-cell v, u, sources and the four reconstructed class inputs as 1 ms means, 60000 bins x 40 cells, plus exact (step, cell) PV spike pairs

integrity_check: the population-mean channels recomputed from the traces must reproduce the numbers sealed in results/v21_pv_predecessor.json post_execution_disclosure to the digits printed there (v_PV baseline -63.750 +- 5.607, late -63.495; sources baseline 3.3786 +- 0.4464, late 3.3866; u_PV baseline -12.411 +- 0.798, late -12.687), and the per-cell early and late rate ranges must match. Otherwise TRACE_IDENTITY_FAILED and stop
interpretation_limit: A and B start from different states by construction, so a per-cell difference at epoch 0 is constitutive and is not by itself evidence of anything. The claim this lineage can support is narrower and is what the criterion below tests: a per-cell representation separates the fates at epochs where the population-mean representation of the same variable does not
null_scale: B and C share an initial state (hash 8704423170e6ae32) and the same fate, and differ only in the noise realization, so the B-C distance at each level is the fate-irrelevant scale. It is zero at epoch 0 and grows as the two runs decorrelate; the scale used is its maximum over the lead window

hierarchy.representation: per-cell epoch-mean v, a 40-vector per epoch
joint per-cell (v, u), standardized by the run-B epoch-0 cell spread
hierarchy.statistic: energy distance between the two 40-point clouds

hierarchy.representation: per-cell within-epoch ISI mean and ISI CV; cells with fewer than 3 spikes in the epoch are excluded and an epoch with fewer than 20 qualifying cells in any run is ineligible
hierarchy.statistic: energy distance between the two clouds

hierarchy.representation: per-cell epoch-mean total reconstructed synaptic input, first 50 ms excluded
hierarchy.condition: evaluated only if levels 1-4 produce no qualifying separation

criterion: at each level and epoch, d(A,B) and d(A,C) must both exceed separation_factor times the maximum of d(B,C) over the lead window, for sustain_epochs consecutive epochs. The qualifying time is the first epoch of that run. In parallel the same test is applied to the population mean of the same variable, using |mean_A - mean_B| and |mean_A - mean_C| against the maximum |mean_B - mean_C| over the lead window
lead_rule: a level qualifies as a predecessor only if its qualifying time is at least precede_ms earlier than the macroscopic PV-rate divergence at 15000 ms
hierarchy_rule: levels are evaluated in order and the first qualifying level is the reported one; lower levels are not searched for a better statistic and no level's statistic is changed after the distances are computed

classification.PV_MICROSTATE_PREDECESSOR: a level qualifies under the criterion and the lead rule, at epochs where the population-mean test of the same variable does not qualify
classification.RECORDED_MICROSTATE_INSUFFICIENT: no level qualifies: the retained microscopic state contains no predecessor, which is the only outcome that would justify another instrumented execution with additional observables
classification.UNRESOLVED: a level separates but the ordering is ambiguous: it does not lead the macroscopic divergence by precede_ms, or the population-mean test qualifies at the same epochs, so the separation is not specific to the microscopic representation
classification.TRACE_IDENTITY_FAILED: the traces do not reproduce the sealed population-mean numbers

forbidden: any simulation, engine call or new execution
adding statistics or levels beyond the five declared, or changing one after seeing a distance
treating the constitutive epoch-0 difference between A and B as evidence
concluding a mechanism: this lineage can locate a representation, not a cause

declaring PV_SPIKE_MICROSTATE falsified because the collapse is uniform across cells: a collective state can differ in phase configuration or joint (v, u) structure while every cell shares the same eventual fate
stop: classify, write results/v21_pv_microstate.json, STOP for review. No intervention and no new execution follows automatically
